name: r2-02-capacity
title: Stage-2 point (b) on the real stack: two lost owners exhaust a tenant's publication capacity
subtitle: tenant-bytes = 600,000,000 fits two reservations of 273,219,584 B (256 MiB capture + 2.56 MiB producer + 2 MiB admission); PR head 50acc2a6
lines: >> Session 1: POST /grants (reserve) reaches the server, reply withheld, Harness SIGKILLed
==   -> publication OPEN / producer OPEN, held 273,219,584 B, command ran 0 times
>> Session 2: same
==   -> publication OPEN / producer OPEN, held 273,219,584 B, command ran 0 times
== both reservations pass expires_at (17:12:07 and 17:12:15), then 10 s more
-- Session 3, fresh and healthy owner: POST /grants -> 400 invalid_request
--   server: IllegalArgumentException "Publication capacity exhausted"; Session recovery-blocked; 0 executions
-- held after expiry: OPEN/OPEN 273,219,584 B ; OPEN/OPEN 273,219,584 B  (never released, never fenced)
note: The author has acknowledged this as open (it needs state-specific reclamation). This run shows it is reachable with an ordinary owner crash between reserve and dispatch, before any fence exists, and that it blocks unrelated Sessions of the same tenant. Before enabling the profile, expired OPEN reservations with no dispatch need to be released or at least excluded from admission.
